relativePaths: All image, state, validation and evidence paths resolve relative to this original Photoshop proof package. Source originals are absolute paths; source anchors refer to sourceEvidence.

source.inventoryDifference: The raw PSD reader and Photoshop expose different layer counts. Native capture, validation and restoration use the exact Photoshop layer set. Raw reader metadata warnings are retained as parser diagnostics and are not a corruption finding.

isolatedBase.finding: Body/chassis shell; selected wheels, spoiler, fascia and other equipment remain separate source layers.

evidence.description: Visible Carbon Fiber Aero Package; TOM uses the letter O. The high wing is the only package component qualified here.

coverage.notice: Spoiler artwork preview for a 2027 ZR1X Coupe 3LZ in the selected paint. Wheels, interior and other equipment remain fixed and may differ from your build.
limitations: TOM shows its high rear wing only; dive planes and the tall hood spoiler are outside coverage.
Other components remain fixed source artwork and may differ from the selected build; this is not a complete configured car or full legal-build proof.

coverage.fallback: Hide the artwork or show an explicit unavailable state outside the exact covered model/year/body/trim/paint/TOM scope. Do not silently substitute.

validation.visualInspection: All ten paint scenes inspected at full-scene scale; TOM carbon-fiber wing geometry, mounts and foreground occlusion inspected at detail scale; isolated body layer inspected separately. No unmatched paint family or compositing artifact observed.
validation.captureMethod: Full native inventory and explicit recipe rendered through the unchanged Photoshop exporter; capture GUI save remains unverified.
